title: Verb forms: every day, yesterday and now

blurb.en: Travel through time with verbs: what you do every day, what happened yesterday and what is happening now.
blurb.vi: Du hành thời gian cùng động từ: việc con làm hằng ngày, điều đã xảy ra hôm qua và điều đang xảy ra bây giờ.

title.vi: Từ chỉ thói quen hằng ngày
Từ chỉ bây giờ và sắp tới

usually.def: Most of the time, but not every time.
usually.ex: I *usually* walk to school with my sister.

always.ex: Omar *always* eats a banana after football practice.

often.ex: We *often* have fish for dinner on Fridays.

never.def: Not at any time, not even once.

routine.def: The things you do at the same time and in the same order every day.
routine.ex: Brushing my teeth is part of my morning *routine*.

yesterday.ex: *Yesterday* I had a sore throat, but today I feel better.

ago.def: Back in the past, before now. Say how long first, like two days.
ago.ex: We moved to this flat three years *ago*.

last.def: The one just before this one, as in the week before this week.
last.ex: There was a big storm *last* Friday.

irregular.def: A verb that does not add -ed in the past, like go and went or eat and ate.
irregular.ex: 'Buy' is an *irregular* verb: the past is 'bought'.

now.def: At this time, at this moment.
now.ex: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping *now*.

tonight.def: This evening or this night, later today.

plan.def: Something you have decided to do later. Use am, is or are + -ing to talk about it.
plan.ex: My *plan* is to read a new book this weekend.

title.vi: Hằng ngày: thì hiện tại đơn

scenes.head: Chloe's blog: My healthy morning
scenes.html: I *get up* at half past six every morning. First, I *wash* my face and *brush* my teeth. Then I *have* breakfast with my family. I usually *eat* a bowl of rice porridge and some fruit. My little brother *doesn't like* fruit, so he *drinks* a glass of milk. My dad never *has* breakfast at home. He *buys* a sandwich on his way to work. *Do* you *eat* a healthy breakfast?

steps.en: The *present simple* is for things we do again and again: *get up*, *have*, *eat*.
steps.vi: Thì *hiện tại đơn* dùng cho những việc ta làm lặp đi lặp lại: *get up*, *have*, *eat*.

steps.en: With he, she and it, add -s or -es: he *drinks*, he *buys*, she *washes*. But have becomes *has*.
steps.vi: Với he, she và it, thêm -s hoặc -es: he *drinks*, he *buys*, she *washes*. Riêng have thành *has*.

steps.en: Negatives: *don't* or *doesn't* + the base verb: he *doesn't like* fruit.
steps.vi: Câu phủ định: *don't* hoặc *doesn't* + động từ nguyên mẫu: he *doesn't like* fruit.

steps.en: Questions: *Do* or *Does* + the base verb: *Do* you *eat* a healthy breakfast?
steps.vi: Câu hỏi: *Do* hoặc *Does* + động từ nguyên mẫu: *Do* you *eat* a healthy breakfast?

title.vi: Hôm qua: thì quá khứ đơn

scenes.head: Grandpa's story about his town
scenes.html: When I *was* nine, our town *was* very small. There *was* one market and there *were* lots of rice fields. There *weren't* any tall buildings. Every morning, I *walked* to school with my friends. We *didn't have* bikes! After school, we *played* by the river and *caught* fish. One day, I *fell* in the water. My mum *was* very angry!

steps.en: The *past simple* is for finished times: when I was nine, *yesterday*, *last* week, two days *ago*.
steps.vi: Thì *quá khứ đơn* dùng cho thời gian đã kết thúc: when I was nine, *yesterday*, *last* week, two days *ago*.

steps.en: Regular verbs add -ed: *walked*, *played*. Irregular verbs change: catch becomes *caught*, fall becomes *fell*.
steps.vi: Động từ có quy tắc thêm -ed: *walked*, *played*. Động từ bất quy tắc thay đổi: catch thành *caught*, fall thành *fell*.

steps.en: *was* for I, he, she and it; *were* for you, we and they. *There was* + one thing; *there were* + many things.
steps.vi: *was* đi với I, he, she, it; *were* đi với you, we, they. *There was* + một vật; *there were* + nhiều vật.

steps.en: Negatives and questions use *didn't* or *Did* + the base verb: we *didn't have* bikes.
steps.vi: Câu phủ định và câu hỏi dùng *didn't* hoặc *Did* + động từ nguyên mẫu: we *didn't have* bikes.

title.en: Now and next: the present continuous
title.vi: Bây giờ và sắp tới: thì hiện tại tiếp diễn

scenes.head: Messages before Tet
scenes.html:
Remy: Hi Bao! What *are* you *doing*?
Bao: I*'m helping* my grandpa. We*'re making* sticky rice cakes for Tet.
Remy: Cool! *Are* you *cooking* them today?
Bao: No, we*'re boiling* them tomorrow. It takes ten hours!
Remy: Wow! What *are* you *doing* on New Year's Eve?
Bao: We*'re watching* the fireworks by the lake. Do you want to come?

steps.en: *am*, *is* or *are* + verb-ing tells us what is happening now: I*'m helping* my grandpa.
steps.vi: *am*, *is* hoặc *are* + động từ thêm -ing cho biết việc đang xảy ra bây giờ: I*'m helping* my grandpa.

steps.en: We also use it for plans with a future time: we*'re boiling* them *tomorrow*.
steps.vi: Ta cũng dùng thì này cho kế hoạch có thời gian trong tương lai: we*'re boiling* them *tomorrow*.

steps.en: Look for the time words: *now* and at the moment mean now; *tomorrow* and on Saturday mean a plan.
steps.vi: Hãy tìm từ chỉ thời gian: *now* và at the moment là bây giờ; *tomorrow* và on Saturday là kế hoạch.

steps.en: Questions: put *am*, *is* or *are* first: *Are* you *cooking* them today?
steps.vi: Câu hỏi: đặt *am*, *is* hoặc *are* lên đầu: *Are* you *cooking* them today?

end.en: Now find the verb forms on your own!
end.vi: Bây giờ con hãy tự tìm các dạng động từ nhé!

challenge.result: You found routines, past events, things happening now and future plans!

v.q: Which sentence is about a routine?
opts: Mai brushes her teeth every day.
Mai is brushing her teeth right now.
Mai brushed her teeth an hour ago.
whys: 'right now' tells you this is happening at this moment, not every day.
'an hour ago' tells you this happened once, in the past.
v.hint: A routine happens again and again. Look for a time word like 'every'.
v.worked: 'every day' means again and again, so 'Mai brushes her teeth every day' is a routine.

v.q: Which sentence tells us about a habit?
opts: Grandpa walks in the park every day.
Grandpa walked in the park on Sunday.
Grandpa is walking in the park now.
whys: 'walked' and 'on Sunday' tell you this happened once, in the past.
'is walking' and 'now' tell you this is happening at this moment.
v.hint: A habit is something you do again and again. Which sentence has 'every'?
v.worked: 'every day' shows a habit, and the present simple 'walks' goes with it.

v.q: Which sentence is about the past?
opts: There are lots of fireworks tonight.
We are watching the fireworks now.
whys: 'are' and 'tonight' tell you this is about today, not the past.
'are watching' and 'now' tell you this is happening at this moment.
v.hint: Look for a past verb and a finished time.
v.worked: 'were' is a past form of 'be', and 'last night' is a finished time.

v.q: Which question asks about the past?
opts: Did Omar have a fever last week?
Does Omar have a fever today?
whys: 'Does' and 'today' ask about now, not the past.
'Is ... feeling' and 'now' ask about this moment.
v.hint: Which helper word starts a past question?
v.worked: 'Did' + 'have' with 'last week' asks about the past.

v.q: Which sentence is happening at this moment?
opts: Look! The children are dancing in the street.
The children danced in the street last year.
The children dance in the street every New Year.
whys: 'danced' and 'last year' tell you this happened in the past.
'every New Year' tells you this happens again and again.
v.hint: Look for am, is or are + -ing, and a word like 'Look!'.
v.worked: 'Look!' and 'are dancing' tell you it is happening now.

v.q: Which sentence tells us what Isla is doing now?
opts: Isla is drawing a cat on the wall.
Isla draws a cat on every birthday card.
Isla drew a cat on the wall.
whys: 'draws' and 'every birthday card' tell you it is a habit, not this moment.
'drew' is the past, so it is finished.
v.hint: Something happening now uses am, is or are + -ing.
v.worked: 'is drawing' = is + -ing, so Isla is doing it now.

v.q: Which sentence is a plan for the future?
opts: We're having a picnic on Sunday.
We had a picnic last Sunday.
We have a picnic every Sunday.
whys: 'had' and 'last Sunday' tell you it is finished.
'every Sunday' tells you it is a habit, not one plan.
v.hint: A plan uses are + -ing with a future time.
v.worked: 'We're having' + 'on Sunday' is a plan for the future.

v.q: Which sentence tells us about a plan?
opts: Ravi is visiting his cousins next week.
Ravi visited his cousins last week.
Ravi visits his cousins every week.
whys: 'visited' and 'last week' tell you it already happened.
'every week' tells you it is a habit.
v.hint: Look for is + -ing with a future time word.
v.worked: 'is visiting' + 'next week' is a plan for the future.

blurb.en: Practise one verb form at a time: every day, yesterday, and now or next.
blurb.vi: Luyện từng dạng động từ một: hằng ngày, hôm qua, và bây giờ hoặc sắp tới.

title.vi: Hằng ngày: thì hiện tại đơn

v.q: My sister ________ a glass of milk every morning.
whys: 'My sister' is one person (she), so the verb needs -s.
'drinking' needs am, is or are before it.
v.hint: Who is the subject? With he, she or it, what do you add to the verb?
v.worked: 'My sister' = she, and 'every morning' is a routine: 'drinks'.

v.q: Omar ________ football in the park after school on Tuesdays.
whys: 'Omar' is one person (he), so the verb needs -s.
'playing' needs is before it, and this is a habit.
v.hint: 'on Tuesdays' means every Tuesday. Who is the subject?
v.worked: 'Omar' = he, and 'on Tuesdays' is a habit: 'plays'.

v.q: ________ your dad cook dinner every evening?
whys: 'Do' goes with I, you, we and they. 'your dad' is he.
'Is' needs a verb with -ing, but here we have 'cook'.
v.hint: Look at the subject and the verb 'cook'. Which helper goes with he?
v.worked: 'your dad' = he, and 'cook' is the base verb, so: 'Does your dad cook...?'

v.q: Isla ________ like spicy food, so she never eats chilli.
whys: 'don't' goes with I, you, we and they. Isla is she.
'isn't' needs an -ing verb or an adjective, but here we have 'like'.
v.hint: Isla is she. Which negative helper goes with she and a base verb?
v.worked: she + negative + base verb: 'Isla doesn't like spicy food'.

v.q: Write the verb in brackets in the correct form.
lines: Ravi always {0} (wash) his hands before lunch.
v.hint: Ravi is he. Verbs that end in -sh add -es.
v.worked: 'always' shows a habit, and with he we add -es to wash: 'washes'.

v.q: Write the verb in brackets in the correct form.
lines: The school bus {0} (stop) outside my flat at seven every morning.
v.hint: 'The school bus' is it. What do you add to the verb with it?
v.worked: 'every morning' shows a routine, and with it we add -s: 'stops'.

title.vi: Hôm qua: thì quá khứ đơn

v.q: ________ you see the fireworks by the lake last night?
whys: 'Do' is for the present, but 'last night' is finished.
'Were' needs an -ing verb or an adjective, but here we have 'see'.
v.hint: Find the time words. Which helper makes a question in the past?
v.worked: 'last night' is in the past, and 'see' is the base verb: 'Did you see...?'

v.q: Nina ________ eat her dinner last night because she had a stomach ache.
whys: 'doesn't' is for the present, but 'last night' is finished.
'don't' is for the present, and it does not go with she.
v.hint: Look at 'last night' and 'had'. Is this now or in the past?
v.worked: 'last night' is the past, so the negative is 'didn't' + eat.

v.q: There ________ thirty children at Ravi's birthday party last Sunday.
whys: 'was' goes with one thing, but 'thirty children' is many.
'are' is for now, but 'last Sunday' is finished.
v.hint: Two clues: is the noun one or many? Is the time now or past?
v.worked: 'thirty children' is plural and 'last Sunday' is past: 'There were'.

v.q: There ________ a big storm last night, so we stayed at home.
whys: 'were' goes with many things, but 'a big storm' is one.
'is' is for now, but 'last night' is finished.
v.hint: Is 'a big storm' one thing or many? Look at the time words too.
v.worked: 'a big storm' is one thing and 'last night' is past: 'There was'.

v.q: Write the verb in brackets in the correct form.
lines: Mum {0} (buy) a bunch of bananas at the market yesterday.
v.hint: 'buy' is an irregular verb. It does not add -ed.
v.worked: 'yesterday' is in the past, and the past of buy is 'bought'.

v.q: Write the verb in brackets in the correct form.
lines: Last week, Lena {0} (find) a lost puppy near the park.
v.hint: 'find' is an irregular verb. It does not add -ed.
v.worked: 'Last week' is in the past, and the past of find is 'found'.

title.en: Now and next: the present continuous
title.vi: Bây giờ và sắp tới: thì hiện tại tiếp diễn

v.q: Shh! The baby ________ in her cot right now.
whys: 'was sleeping' is the past, but 'right now' means this moment.
'sleeps' is for a habit, but 'right now' means this moment.
v.hint: 'Shh!' and 'right now' are clues. What is happening at this moment?
v.worked: 'right now' = this moment, so: is + sleeping.

v.q: Look! Isla ________ a big fish on the wall with chalk.
whys: 'draws' is for a habit, but 'Look!' means it is happening now.
'drew' is the past, but 'Look!' means it is happening now.
v.hint: 'Look!' tells you when it is happening.
v.worked: 'Look!' shows it is happening now, so: is + drawing.

v.q: We are ________ our cousins in Da Nang next weekend.
whys: After 'are', the verb needs -ing.
After 'are', the verb needs -ing, and 'next weekend' is in the future.
v.hint: Look at the word before the gap: 'are'. What form comes after it?
v.worked: A plan with a future time: are + visiting.

v.q: Chloe is ________ a party for her tenth birthday on Saturday.
whys: After 'is', the verb needs -ing.
'had' is the past, but the party is on Saturday, in the future.
v.hint: Look at the word before the gap: 'is'.
v.worked: A plan for Saturday: is + having.

v.q: Write ONE word in the gap.
lines: What {0} you doing tomorrow afternoon?
v.hint: 'doing' ends in -ing. Which helper goes with you?
v.worked: A question about a plan: 'What are you doing tomorrow afternoon?'

v.q: Write ONE word in the gap.
lines: I {0} meeting Nina at the park at four o'clock today.
v.hint: 'meeting' ends in -ing. Which helper goes with I?
v.worked: A plan for later today with I: 'I am meeting Nina'.

blurb.en: Exam practice: choose the verb in a sentence and a message, then write one word in a letter.
blurb.vi: Luyện thi: chọn động từ đúng trong câu và trong tin nhắn, rồi viết một từ vào chỗ trống trong lá thư.

v.q: Mai is a kind girl who ________ her little brother with his maths homework every evening.
whys: 'who' here means Mai, one person, so the verb needs -s.
'helping' needs is before it, and 'every evening' is a habit.
v.hint: Who does 'who' mean here? Look at 'every evening' too.
v.worked: 'who' = Mai (she), and 'every evening' is a habit: 'helps'.

v.q: Omar doesn't like vegetables, but he always ________ a bowl of fruit after lunch.
whys: With he, the present simple verb needs -s.
'eating' needs is before it, and 'always' shows a habit.
v.hint: 'always' shows a habit. Who is the subject: I, you or he?
v.worked: 'he always' + present simple with -s: 'eats'.

v.q: When my grandpa was a boy, there ________ only one small shop in his village.
whys: 'were' goes with many things, but 'one small shop' is one.
'is' is for now, but 'When my grandpa was a boy' is long ago.
v.hint: Two clues: one shop or many? Now or a long time ago?
v.worked: 'When my grandpa was a boy' is the past and 'one small shop' is one thing: 'there was'.

v.q: Last week, Lena ________ some old clothes and toys to a children's centre near her school.
whys: 'takes' is the present, but 'Last week' is finished.
'taking' needs was or is before it.
v.hint: Find the time words at the start of the sentence.
v.worked: 'Last week' is in the past, and the past of take is 'took'.

v.q: Sam can't come to football practice now because he ________ his science homework at the moment.
whys: 'does' is for a habit, but 'at the moment' means now.
'did' is the past, but 'at the moment' means now.
v.hint: 'now' and 'at the moment' are clues. Which form shows what is happening now?
v.worked: 'at the moment' = now, so: is + doing.

v.q: Our class is ________ a fruit salad for the school food fair next Friday, so please bring a banana.
whys: After 'is', the verb needs -ing.
'made' is the past, but 'next Friday' is in the future.
v.hint: Look at the word before the gap and at 'next Friday'.
v.worked: A plan for next Friday: is + making.

title.en: Part 2: a verb in a message
title.vi: Phần 2: động từ trong tin nhắn

v.q: Which option correctly completes the message?
whys: 'were visiting' is the past, but 'this evening' and 'We'll be back' show it hasn't happened yet.
'visited' is the past, but Mum says they will be back at eight, so it hasn't happened yet.
v.hint: When is the visit: before or after Mum wrote the note?
v.worked: 'this evening' and 'We'll be back at eight' show a plan: 'Dad and I are visiting'.

stim.head: A sticky note from Mum
stim.html:
Ravi,
Dad and I ________ your aunt in hospital this evening. Your dinner is in the fridge. Please feed the cat. We'll be back at eight o'clock!
Mum

v.q: Which option correctly completes the message?
whys: 'was looking' is the past, but Isla says 'right now'.
'looked' is the past, but Isla says 'right now'.
v.hint: Find the time words in the message.
v.worked: 'right now' tells you it is happening at this moment: 'I am looking'.

stim.head: A text message
stim.html:
Hi Lena! I ________ at the new street art wall in town right now. There's a giant fish that looks real! Come and see it with me.
Isla

v.q: Which option correctly completes the message?
whys: 'leaves' is for a habit, but 'yesterday' is in the past.
'is leaving' is for now or a plan, but 'yesterday' is in the past.
v.hint: When did it happen? Find the time word.
v.worked: 'yesterday' is in the past, and the past of leave is 'left'.

stim.head: A school notice
stim.html:
LOST PROPERTY
Someone ________ a blue lunch box in the canteen yesterday. It has a rocket sticker on the lid. Please ask at the school office.

v.q: Which option correctly completes the message?
whys: 'have' is for now or habits, but Remy says 'Twelve friends came', so it is finished.
'are having' is for now or a plan, but the party is finished: 'Twelve friends came'.
v.hint: Read the next sentence. Did the party already happen?
v.worked: 'Twelve friends came' and 'made' are past, so the party is finished: 'We had'.

stim.head: An email to Grandma
stim.html:
Dear Grandma,
Thank you for the birthday card! We ________ a great party on Sunday. Twelve friends came and Mum made a big chocolate cake. I miss you!
Love,
Remy

v.q: Which option correctly completes the message?
whys: 'saw' is the past, but 'every weekday' is a routine that is still true.
'is seeing' is for one moment or one plan, but 'every weekday' is a routine.
v.hint: 'every weekday' is a clue. Is this a routine or one moment?
v.worked: 'every weekday' is a routine, and with 'the doctor' (he or she) we say 'sees'.

stim.head: A sign at a health centre
stim.html:
GREEN STREET HEALTH CENTRE
The doctor ________ children from 8 am to 12 pm every weekday. Please come ten minutes early. Children must come with an adult.

v.q: Which option correctly completes the message?
whys: 'met' is the past, but the club still meets: 'Everyone is welcome!'
'meeting' needs 'are' before it.
v.hint: 'every Wednesday' is a clue. Is it a habit or one moment?
v.worked: 'every Wednesday' is a habit, so with we: 'We meet'.

stim.head: A club notice
stim.html:
KINDNESS CLUB
We ________ in Room 5 every Wednesday after school. Today we are making cards for people in hospital. Everyone is welcome!
Nina, club leader

title.en: Part 4: one word in a letter
title.vi: Phần 4: viết một từ vào chỗ trống trong lá thư

v.q: Read the letter. Write ONE word from the box for gap (1).
lines: There {0} only one road and it was very narrow.
v.hint: Is 'one road' one thing or many? Is it now or long ago?
v.worked: Long ago and one road: 'There was only one road'.

stim.head: A letter from Mai
stim.html:
Word box: are, did, gets, is, was, were (example)

Dear Chloe,
I'm writing from my grandma's village. It is very quiet here. Grandma says that when she was young, there (0) were no cars in the village. People walked or rode bikes. There (1) ________ only one road and it was very narrow. Now there is a new school and a small clinic. Every morning, Grandma (2) ________ up at five o'clock and feeds her chickens. Tomorrow we (3) ________ picking oranges in her garden. I can't wait!
Love,
Mai

v.q: Read the email. Write ONE word from the box for gap (1).
lines: I {0} a bad cough and a fever last night.
v.hint: 'last night' is a clue. Which word from the box is in the past?
v.worked: 'last night' is finished, so the past of have: 'I had a bad cough'.

lines: Every morning, Grandma {0} up at five o'clock and feeds her chickens.
v.hint: 'Every morning' shows a routine. Look at 'feeds' after the gap too.
v.worked: A routine with she: 'Grandma gets up at five o'clock'.

lines: The doctor {0} me some medicine and told me to drink lots of water.
v.hint: Look at 'told' later in the sentence. Is this now or in the past?
v.worked: 'told' is past, so the other verb is past too: the past of give is 'gave'.

lines: Tomorrow we {0} picking oranges in her garden.

v.worked: A plan with we: 'we are picking oranges'.

items.en: Use the *present simple* for routines, habits and things that are always true. With he, she and it, add *-s* or *-es*.
items.vi: Dùng *thì hiện tại đơn* cho thói quen, việc làm thường ngày và những điều luôn đúng. Với he, she, it thì thêm *-s* hoặc *-es*.

items.en: Present simple negatives and questions: *don't / doesn't* + the base verb; *Do / Does* + the base verb.
items.vi: Câu phủ định và câu hỏi ở hiện tại đơn: *don't / doesn't* + động từ nguyên mẫu; *Do / Does* + động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.en: Use the *past simple* for finished times (yesterday, last week, ago). Regular verbs add *-ed*; irregular verbs change.
items.vi: Dùng *thì quá khứ đơn* cho thời gian đã kết thúc (yesterday, last week, ago). Động từ có quy tắc thêm *-ed*; động từ bất quy tắc thì thay đổi.
example: I *went* to bed early because I *had* a headache.

items.en: *was* for I, he, she, it; *were* for you, we, they. Use *there was* for one thing and *there were* for many things.
items.vi: *was* đi với I, he, she, it; *were* đi với you, we, they. Dùng *there was* cho một vật và *there were* cho nhiều vật.
example: *There was* a big tree in the garden.
*There were* twenty children at the party.

items.en: Past simple negatives and questions: *didn't* + the base verb; *Did* + the base verb.
items.vi: Câu phủ định và câu hỏi ở quá khứ đơn: *didn't* + động từ nguyên mẫu; *Did* + động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.en: Use the *present continuous* (am / is / are + -ing) for now AND for future plans with a time word.
items.vi: Dùng *thì hiện tại tiếp diễn* (am / is / are + -ing) cho việc đang xảy ra bây giờ VÀ cho kế hoạch tương lai có từ chỉ thời gian.

check.sentence: {Does|Do|Is} your dad cook dinner every day?
Last summer we {went|go|goes} to the beach.
There {were|was|is} lots of people at the market yesterday.
I {didn't eat|don't eat|doesn't eat} breakfast this morning because I was late.
We {are having|had|have} a barbecue next Saturday.

v.q: Every year before Tet, Bao ________ his grandpa make sticky rice cakes in the kitchen.
whys: 'Bao' is one person (he), so the verb needs -s.
'helping' needs is before it, and 'Every year' is a habit.
v.hint: 'Every year' is a clue. Who is the subject?
v.worked: 'Every year' shows a habit, and Bao is he: 'helps'.

v.q: Lena loves animals, and she ________ at an animal shelter near her flat every Sunday.
whys: With she, the present simple verb needs -s.
'helping' needs is before it, and 'every Sunday' is a habit.
v.hint: 'every Sunday' is a clue. Who is the subject?
v.worked: 'every Sunday' shows a habit, and with she: 'helps'.

v.q: Last year, Bao ________ all the banana leaves very carefully in a big bowl of water.
whys: 'washes' is the present, but 'Last year' is finished.
'washing' needs was or is before it.
v.hint: Find the time words at the start of the sentence.
v.worked: 'Last year' is in the past, so add -ed: 'washed'.

v.q: Last Sunday, a kind man ________ a little brown puppy to the shelter in a box.
whys: 'brings' is the present, but 'Last Sunday' is finished.
'bringing' needs was or is before it.
v.hint: Find the time words at the start of the sentence.
v.worked: 'Last Sunday' is in the past, and the past of bring is 'brought'.

v.q: That night, there ________ twenty cakes in the huge pot on Grandpa's fire.
whys: 'was' goes with one thing, but 'twenty cakes' is many.
'are' is for now, but 'That night' is in the past.
v.hint: Two clues: one thing or many? Now or in the past?
v.worked: 'twenty cakes' is many and 'That night' is past: 'there were'.

v.q: The puppy was very hungry, and there ________ some small cuts on its legs.
whys: 'was' goes with one thing, but 'some small cuts' is many.
'are' is for now, but 'was very hungry' tells you it is the past.
v.hint: Is 'some small cuts' one thing or many? Look at 'was' at the start too.
v.worked: 'some small cuts' is many and the story is in the past: 'there were'.

v.q: Bao ________ to bed until midnight because he wanted to see the cakes come out of the pot.
whys: 'doesn't go' is for a habit now, but 'wanted' tells you it is the past.
'isn't going' is for now or a plan, but 'wanted' tells you it is the past.
v.hint: Look at the verb 'wanted' later in the sentence. Is this now or in the past?
v.worked: 'he wanted' is past, so the negative is 'didn't' + go.

v.q: Lena ________ the puppy's name, so she called it Biscuit.
whys: 'doesn't know' is the present, but 'called' tells you it is the past.
'don't know' is the present and does not go with she.
v.hint: Look at 'called' later in the sentence. Is this now or in the past?
v.worked: 'she called it' is past, so the negative is 'didn't' + know.

v.q: This year, Bao is ________ the cakes with his cousins next Saturday afternoon.
whys: After 'is', the verb needs -ing.
'made' is the past, but 'next Saturday' is in the future.
v.hint: Look at the word before the gap and at 'next Saturday'.
v.worked: A plan for next Saturday: is + making.

v.q: Lena is ________ the puppy again next Sunday, and she wants to take it a toy.
whys: After 'is', the verb needs -ing.
'visited' is the past, but 'next Sunday' is in the future.
v.hint: Look at the word before the gap and at 'next Sunday'.
v.worked: A plan for next Sunday: is + visiting.
